teaser: A door held open for no one. A plan filed before anyone asked for it. You carry life path 1, the path of the leader, inside an INTJ's private architecture of strategy and certainty. The crossing here is not ambition meeting intellect — both already assume command — it is what happens when the same person insists on being first and insists on being right. The 1 wants to lead by instinct. The INTJ wants to lead by design. Watch what happens when a plan outlives the moment it was built for.
excerpt: The restaurant where the host has lost the reservation twice, and you are rebuilding the evening before anyone else finishes being annoyed — a different table, a plan named before the waiter returns.
